notes: Published in the MCP Registry as com.kajabi/kajabi and covered in Kajabi's help centre. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256, public clients.

name: Campaign Monitor
alternative: OAuth app registered once under Integrations > OAuth Registration
notes: No official MCP found; API key from Account Settings over HTTP Basic auth, or OAuth after a self-serve app registration.

name: Hotjar
alternative: the person's survey and feedback exports (CSV)
notes: No Hotjar MCP found; Contentsquare (Hotjar's owner) markets an MCP server but Hotjar coverage is not stated. The Hotjar API reference blocked automated access, so its auth and plan limits are unconfirmed.

name: Teachable
alternative: none
notes: No official MCP found; school owners create an API key under Settings > API and send it in an apiKey header. Plan requirement not confirmed.

name: Jenkins
alternative: none
notes: Official Jenkins project plugin (jenkinsci/mcp-server-plugin) adds an MCP endpoint at /mcp-server/mcp on the person's own Jenkins; signs in with the user's Jenkins API token over Basic auth. Open source and self-hosted. Class B setup: the person installs the vendor's local MCP server and gives it a free self-serve personal access token; there is no app registration or vendor review.

name: Redis
alternative: none
notes: Official local server (PyPI redis-mcp-server, stdio) connecting with the person's own Redis URL, username and password; nothing for the project to register. Class B setup: the person installs the vendor's local MCP server and gives it a free self-serve personal access token; there is no app registration or vendor review.

name: NetSuite
alternative: NetSuite SuiteTalk REST API
notes: Oracle's AI Connector Service is a per-account remote MCP ({accountid} is the NetSuite account ID) using OAuth code with PKCE and a public-client integration record the account admin creates; no review. Connector is free; NetSuite itself is sold by contract.

name: Less Annoying CRM
alternative: none
notes: No official MCP; community server github.com/optimize-overseas/lacrm-mcp, not official (registry entry is a third-party proxy). The v2 API takes a per-user API key the account creates in Settings with no review; LACRM is a paid self-serve subscription with a trial.

name: Stack Overflow
alternative: Stack Exchange API with a registered app key
notes: Official beta remote server; the person signs in with a Stack Exchange account, 100 calls per day per user. Docs connect through mcp-remote (implies dynamic registration), but plain GET discovery returned 404 on 2026-10-08, so the sign-in route is unconfirmed.

name: PostgreSQL
alternative: none
notes: The PostgreSQL project ships no MCP; the former reference server is archived and Postgres MCP Pro (github.com/crystaldba/postgres-mcp) is community, not official. A local tool can connect with the person's own connection string.

name: JetBrains
alternative: none
notes: IntelliJ-based IDEs since 2025.2 bundle an MCP server (SSE, stdio or HTTP stream) running locally inside the IDE; no account sign-in. Paid IDE editions may apply depending on the IDE. Class B setup: the person installs or turns on the vendor's local MCP server, which uses no Kipster sign-in (it relies on the app's own session or its own sign-in, where it has one); there is no app registration or vendor review.

name: Iterable
alternative: none
notes: Official local server (npm @iterable/mcp) using an Iterable API key the customer creates; no project registration. Iterable is sold to businesses. Class B setup: the person installs the vendor's local MCP server and gives it a self-serve API key; there is no app registration or vendor review.

name: Descript
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server with Descript login; discovery 2026-10-08: auth.descript.com advertises DCR and CIMD with S256. Imports and edits use the plan's media minutes and AI credits.

name: Braze
alternative: Braze REST API with a workspace API key
notes: Official remote server; discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, S256. Braze keeps an allowlist of client domains, so unlisted clients may be blocked; an admin must also enable MCP OAuth access.

name: DigitalOcean
alternative: none
notes: Official remote servers, one per product (App Platform shown; Droplets, Databases and others on sibling hosts). Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD false, S256; an API token as bearer also works. Resources are pay-as-you-go.

name: CrowdStrike
alternative: Official local falcon-mcp with a Falcon API client ID and secret
notes: CrowdStrike hosts a remote MCP on its own domain, signed in through the Falcon API's OAuth server (US-1 host); it is not in public docs, and a user report of an MCP clients page in the Falcon console suggests an admin may need to allow the client. The local falcon-mcp (maintained by CrowdStrike, pre-1.0) is the documented fallback. Falcon is sold to businesses. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD yes, S256 yes.

name: Resend
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server; discovery 2026-10-08: auth server api.resend.com advertises DCR and CIMD with S256. An API key as bearer also works; free plan has a sending quota.

name: Sanity
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server with OAuth; discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256. An API token in the Authorization header also works; image tools use AI credits.

name: Postscript
alternative: Private API key the shop creates in Postscript (REST API)
notes: Postscript hosts an OAuth MCP on its own domain with a read-only analytics scope (mcp:analytics.read); it is not yet in the public developer docs. Postscript serves Shopify merchants. Community server github.com/mattcoatsworth/postscript-mcp-server, not official. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256 yes.

name: Heroku
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server with Heroku OAuth; discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256. Running apps on Heroku is billed; plan details not checked here.

name: Microsoft Advertising
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server (open beta, read-focused) using Microsoft identity OAuth with a client ID from a free Entra app registration that allows personal accounts; no review. Connecting is free.

name: Tavily
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server; discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256. API key in URL or header also works; free monthly credits, paid above that.

name: Affinity (design)
alternative: none
notes: Canva ships a local MCP server built into the Affinity 3.2+ Mac app (enable in Settings > Model Context Protocol; runs only while the app is open), exposing scripting tools, so the URL is the app's download page. Affinity is free for individuals; only Anthropic's connector listing documents the MCP, not a vendor page. Class B setup: the person installs or turns on the vendor's local MCP server, which uses no Kipster sign-in (it relies on the app's own session or its own sign-in, where it has one); there is no app registration or vendor review.

name: Microsoft Power Automate
alternative: Dataverse MCP server for the environment, if an admin allows the client
notes: No Power Automate MCP; community server github.com/andrewcharlwood/power-automate-mcp, not official, uses the unsupported api.flow.microsoft.com. Supported route is the Dataverse Web API with a free Entra app registration, solution flows only and work accounts; Dataverse's own MCP needs admin client allowlisting and Copilot credits. The route manages the person's own flows (definitions, on/off state, sharing, export); flows run in Microsoft's cloud and their connectors reach other services, but the Web API returns flow records rather than proxying those services' data.

name: Salesloft
alternative: Salesloft REST API with an OAuth app
notes: Official read-only remote server; discovery 2026-10-08: 401 points to metadata, auth server accounts.salesloft.com/mcp advertises DCR, S256, client-secret methods only. Needs the Agentic add-on and an admin toggle (per third-party reports).

name: Bubble
alternative: Each app's Data API with an admin API token
notes: Bubble's official MCP lets the person's AI tool create and edit their Bubble apps after signing in with their Bubble account; it needs CIMD client support, the app's plan limits apply, and new apps start on the Free plan. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD yes, S256 yes.

name: Toast
alternative: Toast reports exported as CSV
notes: No official MCP found. Restaurant operators can get read-only Standard API access credentials (client credentials) for their own locations; write access and products for others go through the partner programme. Restaurant customers only.

name: Ahrefs
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server; discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256. MCP needs a paid Ahrefs plan from Lite up; an MCP key as bearer also works.

name: Fivetran
alternative: Fivetran REST API (api.fivetran.com/v1) with the same scoped API key and secret
notes: Official local server run with uvx from github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp, using a scoped API key and secret the person generates in the Fivetran dashboard; it is read-only unless FIVETRAN_SCOPE allows writes. Its tools wrap the Fivetran REST API, so they manage the person's own account (connections, destinations, groups, users, transformations, sync status) and do not return the third-party data Fivetran syncs, which lands in the person's destination. No hosted endpoint; the registry entry is community (YimingYAN).

name: Clover
alternative: none
notes: No official MCP; community server github.com/SBolivarLoL/clover-mcp-server, not official. A merchant can generate its own API token in the Clover Dashboard with no app approval; public apps go through Clover's app approval. Merchants only.

name: Bitly
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server (registry com.bitly/mcp); discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256. An API token from Bitly settings also works.

name: Better Stack
alternative: none
notes: Official remote server; discovery 2026-10-08: 401 points to metadata, DCR yes on betterstack.com, CIMD not advertised, S256. API token as bearer also works.

name: Dext
alternative: The person's CSV export of items from the Dext costs or sales inbox or Archive; or connect the accounting software Dext publishes to (Xero, QuickBooks)
notes: Dext documents exporting cost and sales items as CSV, including custom CSV formats; Dext is a paid service. Its AI Connector (MCP) is an open beta for Practice Advanced accounts, offered only to Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot workspaces; its endpoint is not published and no self-serve API was found, so no MCP URL is recorded. Registry 2026-10-08: no Dext server.

name: Braintree
alternative: none
notes: No official MCP; community servers such as github.com/QuentinCody/braintree-mcp-server, not official. Merchants use their own API keys; sandbox is self-serve, production accounts go through sales.

name: Fly.io
alternative: none
notes: Official flyctl MCP server (fly mcp server, stdio by default) using the person's Fly.io access token. Fly.io bills usage. Class B setup: the person installs the vendor's local MCP server and gives it a self-serve personal access token; there is no app registration or vendor review.

name: Context7
alternative: none
notes: Official Upstash server; discovery 2026-10-08: auth server clerk.context7.com advertises DCR and CIMD with S256. Works without sign-in at low rate limits; a free API key raises them.

name: Podium
alternative: Podium data exports or notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No official MCP; community server github.com/hoainho/podium-mcp, not official. API apps need a Podium developer account, granted after an application review of a few days.
